natural_language_analysis.summary: All three target VCs are semantically valid. The common spatial argument splits a dll segment at linklist_node_pre or joins a prefix segment, the node's two link cells, and a suffix segment. The two return VCs additionally recover whether nodes_after is empty or begins with node_next from the recursive dllseg definition.

vc_shape.pre_exists: The xizi_dll definition hides sentinel first/last; splitting at linklist_node_pre hides node_prev/node_next.
vc_shape.post_spatial: Sentinel next/prev cells, the prefix dllseg ending at linklist_node_pre, linklist_node_pre next/prev cells, and the suffix dllseg ending at the sentinel.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Open xizi_dll to obtain first and last; instantiate node_prev and node_next with the boundary values obtained by splitting the segment whose logical list is nodes_before ++ linklist_node_pre :: nodes_after.
witnesses.space_plan: Choose the first disjunct. Apply xizi_dll_open, then a proved segment-splitting helper by induction on nodes_before. Keep the sentinel link cells as frame and expose exactly the node link cells plus the two segments required by the postcondition.
witnesses.pure_plan: The postcondition's only pure fact is exactly PreH2. The recursive nonempty clauses used by the splitting helper supply node equality, non-NULL, and non-stop facts at every traversed list element.
premise_discharge: The split helper requires no external semantic assumption: the full segment over nodes_before ++ linklist_node_pre :: nodes_after contains all non-NULL/non-stop facts in its recursive clauses.
witnesses.grouping_reason: This witness produces the same prefix/node/suffix boundary consumed by both return witnesses.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: Sentinel link cells, prefix dllseg, linklist_node_pre link cells with node_next = linklist_pre, and dllseg linklist_pre linklist_node_pre linklist_pre last nodes_after.
vc_shape.post_spatial: The original xizi_dll over nodes_before ++ linklist_node_pre :: nodes_after.
vc_shape.post_exists: The xizi_dll closure hides the already available first and last.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Choose the first disjunct and reuse first/last when closing xizi_dll. The suffix segment begins at its stop because node_next = linklist_pre, hence its recursive definition forces nodes_after = nil and node_prev/last boundary equality; the return value reduces to 0.
witnesses.space_plan: Unfold or use a small at-stop helper on the suffix segment to obtain nodes_after = nil and its emp boundary equality. Recompose the prefix, linklist_node_pre link cells, and empty suffix with the join helper; combine with the framed sentinel link cells and apply xizi_dll_close.
witnesses.pure_plan: Substitute node_next = linklist_pre. Destruct nodes_after: the nil branch yields value 0 by unfolding xizi_double_link_next_rec_last_value; the cons branch contains the impossible pure condition linklist_pre <> linklist_pre from dllseg. linklist_node_pre <> NULL is PreH2. linklist_node_pre <> linklist_pre follows from disjoint ownership of the sentinel and node link fields in the chosen first disjunct (equality would make two separating points-to cells overlap).
premise_discharge: join pivot <> stop: disjoint sentinel/node field ownership; equality contradicts separating points-to resources
at-stop result: direct case analysis of XiziDLL.dllseg
witnesses.grouping_reason: Uses the inverse segment operation and the same boundary data as the entail witness.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: Sentinel link cells, prefix dllseg, linklist_node_pre link cells, and a suffix dllseg beginning at node_next.
vc_shape.pre_exists: none in the first disjunct; unfolding the suffix exposes its rest and next pointer.
vc_shape.post_spatial: The original xizi_dll over nodes_before ++ linklist_node_pre :: nodes_after.
vc_shape.post_exists: The xizi_dll closure hides first and last.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Choose the first disjunct. Since node_next <> linklist_pre, xizi_dllseg_unfold on the suffix yields a rest with nodes_after = node_next :: rest. This equation makes xizi_double_link_next_rec_last_value nodes_after reduce to node_next.
witnesses.space_plan: Expose the nonempty suffix boundary with xizi_dllseg_unfold (or equivalent controlled unfolding), retain/rebuild that suffix, join it to the prefix through linklist_node_pre with the shared join helper, then frame the sentinel link cells and apply xizi_dll_close.
witnesses.pure_plan: PreH1 rules out the empty suffix clause, whose equality would force node_next = linklist_pre. The nonempty clause yields nodes_after = node_next :: rest, node_next <> NULL, and node_next <> linklist_pre. Unfolding the value definition proves the return equality. linklist_node_pre <> NULL is PreH2; linklist_node_pre <> linklist_pre is derived from disjoint sentinel/node field ownership as in return_wit_1.
premise_discharge: suffix nonempty: PreH1 contradicts the nil dllseg boundary equation
join pivot <> stop: disjoint sentinel/node field ownership
witnesses.grouping_reason: Shares the segment join and xizi_dll closure proof with return_wit_1; differs only in nonempty-suffix pure reasoning.

analysis_groups.shared_proof_pattern: Open/split or join/close a circular doubly linked segment at linklist_node_pre.
analysis_groups.shared_space_plan: Use proved dllseg split/join facts and existing xizi_dll_open/xizi_dll_close, preserving sentinel cells as frame.
analysis_groups.shared_pure_plan: Use recursive dllseg clauses for list-shape equations and non-NULL/non-stop facts; derive sentinel/node inequality from disjoint field ownership where required.
analysis_groups.grouping_reason: All witnesses are from the same function and use one segment boundary/helper family; 3 witnesses is below the controller maximum of 12.

proof_groups.proof_strategy: Prove group-suffixed dllseg split/join helpers by induction on nodes_before, plus an at-stop-empty helper by destructing nodes_after. For entail_wit_1 choose the first disjunct, open xizi_dll, and split at linklist_node_pre. For each return witness choose the first disjunct, establish the suffix list shape, join the segments through linklist_node_pre, and close xizi_dll; unfold xizi_double_link_next_rec_last_value to discharge the return equality.
proof_groups.grouping_reason: Same function, same dllseg boundary, same split/join helper family, and sequential proof context; the group size 3 is within max_witnesses_per_group 12.

candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: forall first prev pivot stop last prefix suffix, xizi_dllseg first prev stop last (prefix ++ pivot :: suffix) |-- EX pivot_prev next, xizi_dllseg first prev pivot pivot_prev prefix ** xizi_dll_links pivot next pivot_prev ** xizi_dllseg next pivot stop last suffix

forall first prev pivot pivot_prev next stop last prefix suffix, pivot <> NULL -> pivot <> stop -> xizi_dllseg first prev pivot pivot_prev prefix ** xizi_dll_links pivot next pivot_prev ** xizi_dllseg next pivot stop last suffix |-- xizi_dllseg first prev stop last (prefix ++ pivot :: suffix)
